title: Arizona Cardinals Running Back James Conner, The Cigna Group and Nonprofit Organizations Come Together To Support Arizona Children and Families

body_markdown:
**GLENDALE, Ariz., October 8, 2026** - Arizona Cardinals running back James Conner joined 350 employees of The Cigna Group and local nonprofit organizations at State Farm Stadium for a volunteer service event supporting children and families across Arizona. The event combined hands-on service, charitable giving and community partnerships to support organizations working to improve the health and well-being of local communities.


Employees assembled doctor’s office playsets and playroom furniture for area Ronald McDonald Houses and 1,000 youth outreach packs for distribution through Phoenix Children's Foundation. The event also featured a community nonprofit fair connecting employees with Phoenix-area organizations and opportunities to continue serving locally.


Employees worked side by side to assemble doctor office playsets, playroom furniture and youth outreach packs for local nonprofit organizations.


**Supporting children and families through hands-on service**


As a cancer survivor, Conner has spoken openly about the role care, resilience and community support played in his own experience. At the event, he joined employees in the volunteer activities and discussed the importance of showing up for children and families navigating serious health challenges.


“My own experience with cancer taught me how much it matters to know you have people in your corner,” said James Conner, Arizona Cardinals running back. “I am proud to join The Cigna Group and these local organizations to create something tangible that can bring comfort, encouragement and support to young people across Arizona.”


“Supporting the health and well-being of children requires a community that is willing to invest in their future. Through this partnership, The Cigna Group volunteers are making a meaningful difference for children and families who need encouragement and support. These kits are going to our Homeless Youth Outreach program and will help us extend compassionate care beyond our hospital walls and into the communities we serve,” said Tim Harrison, vice president, corporate partnerships, special events and grant philanthropy at Phoenix Children’s.


350 employees of The Cigna Group gathered in Glendale for a day of volunteer service, community partnership and charitable giving.


**Investing in organizations that strengthen Arizona communities**


The event builds on The Cigna Group's broader commitment to Arizona communities. In 2025, The Cigna Group contributed more than $9.2 million through donations and sponsorships across the state, while employees contributed nearly 4,500 volunteer hours. These efforts reflect a long-standing commitment to partnering with organizations that help children, families and communities thrive.


David Cordani, executive chair of The Cigna Group Board of Directors, joined James Conner at the event to discuss the importance of supporting the health and well-being of the next generation. As part of that commitment, The David and Sherry Cordani Family Foundation announced a donation to Phoenix Children's Foundation to fund additional outreach packs for young people served through Phoenix Children's Homeless Youth Outreach Program.


"The best solutions for community impact are built together,” said Sara Quist, senior director of community programs at The Cigna Group and president of The Cigna Group Foundation. “By working alongside local nonprofits, we seek to provide the help that is needed most for kids and families across Arizona.”


**About The Cigna Group**


The Cigna Group (NYSE: CI) is a global health company committed to creating a better future built on the vitality of every individual and every community. We relentlessly challenge ourselves to partner and innovate solutions for better health. The Cigna Group includes products and services marketed under Evernorth Health Services, Cigna Healthcare, or its subsidiaries. The Cigna Group maintains sales capabilities in more than 30 markets and jurisdictions, and has over 180 million customer relationships around the world. Learn more at thecignagroup.com.


**About The Cigna Group Foundation**


The Cigna Group Foundation is a private foundation funded by contributions from The Cigna Group (NYSE: CI) and its subsidiaries. The Cigna Group Foundation aims to support, collaborate and convene with nonprofit organizations addressing society's greatest health challenges. In addition to increasing access to programs and care in geographies demonstrating significant need, the Foundation responds with humanitarian aid relief during critical times and strengthens colleagues' support of causes through matching donations and volunteer rewards. To learn more, visit www.thecignagroup.com/community.
